LanguageData.LP_Role_Cleric.label: priest
LanguageData.LP_Role_Cleric.description: A cleric serving the culture's god. Divine magic cost ×0.75 (multiplies with believer and chosen-one discounts), social impact +10%; can use "miracle preaching" (twice as effective as vanilla convert, costs an extra 5 patron deity divine favor); while a priest is on the map, the altar gets an extra "group prayer" button; festivals and grey-robed funerals get +15% quality with a priest present. Requires a deity meme or the pantheon.
